comment: Post-onboarding client satisfaction (brief 5.6): one row per survey response 2-6 weeks after go-live, with the 1-5 score, sentiment (Negative 1-2, Neutral 3, Positive 4-5), comment theme (Turnaround Time, Relationship Manager, Account Setup, Digital Portal, Communication, Document Requests) and short comment text, plus the onboarding case it rates (booking country, segment, days to live). Average satisfaction = AVG(satisfaction_score); negative themes = COUNT(*) WHERE is_negative grouped by theme. Grain: one row per survey response.
